newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends little changed in thin trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended little changed after a quiet day with lack of overseas participation limiting activity, dealers said.
"There was little interest from the West as most Europeans are still on the summer break," a dealer said.
Some scattered enquiries were seen from Taiwan and South Korea for SMR rubber for nearby shipments.
Dealers added that some local condom/gloves manufacturers were also making enquiries for latex rubber which are currently quoting at around 250-252 cents.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board set market indicator price for October RSS1 buyer and October SMR 20 buyer at 330.50 cents ($1.32) and 317 cents a kg respectively.
Traders quoted SMR10 sellers at 321 cents, SMR CV at 380-382 and SMR L at 360.
The INRO five-day average was 252.13 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Sept 4 from 251.40 on Sept 3. The daily indicator price was 253.21 against 252.77.
